title: Libre Sensor Upload Gap Over Eight Hours
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=libre:glucose
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sensor_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>8
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Libre CGM uploads telemetry to monitor time since each sensor last sent data in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for wear or sync issues before you lose the day, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Libre CGM uploads data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Sensor table ranked by hours since last upload.
grandmaExplanation: It blends time since each sensor last sent data so you can spot wear or sync issues before you lose the day before it becomes annoying.
